description.narrative: These will be measured with the numbers of capacity building programmes delivered to the CMAs. A number of capacity building programmes would be rolled out for the CMAs and LAFA. The capacity building programme included: financial management; leadership; communication; advocacy; business management; computer literacy; CMA formation process; DASE training; Village Savings and Loan Association (VSLA); office space; offgrid solar power; strategic planing

comment.narrative: As of 2020 the capacity building programme the CMA benefited from was the training on the use of DASE the IUU monitoring and reporting app

All CMA leadership capacity in governance management and advocacy attained to an agreed level over the period of the project.That is the CMAs should have benefited from the listed capacity building programme included financial management leadership communication advocacy business management computer literacy CMA formation process DASE training Village Savings and Loan Association VSLA office space offgrid solar power strategic planing
